_why: #11/H4: the hand-run delta review found fix-introduced defects in 3 of 3 passes, and the hand-rolled instrument failed twice in one sitting — a review whose instrument fails silently reports CLEAN. Each row restores one way this script can report a clean or useless delta: by reviewing the wrong lines, by executing text from prose that was never meant to run, by dropping a cannot-judge, or by flooding the report until a reader ignores it.

mutations.name: every-backticked-span-is-a-claim-again
mutations._mechanism: Measured on the real commit 8af16d9: without the command-shape filter this reported `claims=15 executed=0 unverified=15`, every one an identifier (`doc-auditor`, `DIVERGED`, `[H-MAD]`, `--sentence-file`). An alert that is always wrong is worse than no alert — the reader stops reading it, and the two real claims on a90c365 are then buried.

mutations.name: removed-lines-are-reviewed-too
mutations._mechanism: A claim the revision DELETED is reported as one the revision makes, so the reviewer re-runs commands about text that is already gone and the real added claims are diluted.
mutations.replace: if not line.startswith("+++") and not line.startswith("---"):

mutations.name: the-allowlist-is-matched-as-a-substring
mutations._mechanism: `rm -rf / # grep` contains `grep` and would be executed. The verb is the whole safety property; a substring test hands prose examples to subprocess.
mutations.replace: return any(a in command for a in _ALLOWED)

mutations.name: shell-metacharacters-no-longer-refuse-execution
mutations._mechanism: A redirect, a pipe or a substitution out of a document's prose gets run. The canary test writes a real file if this fires — the script would be executing text an author wrote to illustrate, not to run.

mutations.name: unverified-claims-vanish-from-the-verdict-line
mutations._mechanism: The count of what could NOT be checked disappears, so a delta with ten unrunnable claims and none executed reads exactly like a clean one. A cannot-judge that is not in the token is a pass.

mutations.name: a-revision-git-cannot-read-is-reported-CLEAN
mutations._mechanism: The exact shape this repo keeps paying for: 'I could not measure it' spelled the same way as 'I measured it and it is fine'. A typo'd rev then certifies a delta nobody reviewed.
mutations.find:
if lines is None:
        print(f"DELTA: UNREADABLE reason=git:{args.rev}")
